step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture diagram illustrates a hybrid live media ingestion and clip editing pipeline for RSI (Radio Televisione Svizzera). It is divided into two main processing flows:

1. **Live Stream Ingestion Flow (Flow 0)**: On-premises live camera feeds are ingested by dual redundant Elemental Live appliances for high availability. These appliances stream live video streams across the network perimeter into AWS MediaPackage. MediaPackage records the live streams into an S3 bucket (Live Storage) as 14-day rolling video chunk playlists.

2. **Clip Editing & Publishing Flow (Flow 1)**: An on-premises MAM (Multimedia Asset Manager) platform allows operators to select clip edit points (in/out timestamps, logo overlays, target resolution variants). Edit events are dispatched via API Gateway into AWS Step Functions for orchestration. API Gateway logs initial request metadata into DynamoDB. Step Functions fetches chunk source files from S3 Live Storage, orchestrates transcoding requests to AWS MediaConvert, and updates workflow execution status and debugging metadata in DynamoDB. MediaConvert renders the clip variants and poster images, writing them directly into the S3 Origin Server bucket for consumption by external media players.
